summary: People keep coming back to "sticks the landing" because the movie turns identity panic into a cold, elegant dread. It is sleek, unsettling, and built around the fear that a fresh start might not fix anything.
good_pick_if: You want existential unease and a clean, clinical kind of suspense.
maybe_skip_if: You want a comfort watch or a movie that hands you easy answers.

summary: People say it "made me cry," but the draw is really the devastated, humane atmosphere. It is post-apocalyptic grief with a stubborn pulse of life underneath.
good_pick_if: You want bleak sci-fi that still cares about people.
maybe_skip_if: You want action or hope delivered lightly.

summary: People call it "thoughtful sci-fi done right," which gets at the appeal without overselling it. It is a brainy first-contact movie that stays calm while the stakes keep growing, and it is more interested in understanding than spectacle.
good_pick_if: You want thoughtful sci-fi that still lands emotionally.
maybe_skip_if: You want noisy invasion action or constant plot churn.

summary: People keep calling it a "coke-fueled rise and fall," which is exactly the point. It is excess, swagger, and self-destruction all at once, and that operatic scale is the hook.
good_pick_if: You want maximalist crime energy and big iconic lines.
maybe_skip_if: You want restraint or subtle moral shading.

summary: The appeal is right there in "IT'S LITERALLY HOT WHEELS": it is a pure velocity movie built on color, chaos, and almost embarrassing commitment to the bit. If you want a night of pure motion, this is the one.
good_pick_if: You want maximum sensory noise and a movie that never lets up.
maybe_skip_if: You want grounded stakes or a calmer pace.

summary: The line about "one of the hardest shots in all of cinema" captures the whole deal: it is a crowd-pleaser built on clean suspense and impeccable scale. The thrills are still sharp because the movie knows exactly when to hold back.
good_pick_if: You want a blockbuster that still feels precise and rewatchable.
maybe_skip_if: You want something small or dialogue-heavy.

summary: "SO THIS IS WHAT IT FEELS LIKE" is a fair reaction, because the movie plays like a bruised farewell more than a standard superhero ride. It is rugged, intimate, and unusually willing to sit in exhaustion and care.

maybe_skip_if: You want bright, quippy, or plot-light superhero energy.
